The '''''Acclamator II''-class assault ship''', also referred to as the '''''Acclamator II''-class transgalactic military assault ship''', was an assault ship based on the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] and was first used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ''Acclamator II''-class was designed primarily to carry out [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]], and as such its troop complement was reduced by nearly eighty percent in order to make room for the added weaponry.<ref name="Saga Edition" /> Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ''Acclamator II''-class assault ships were often used to reinforce the defense of [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class space stations]].<ref name="Wizards" /> At least two were also used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] at the [[Battle of Mindor]].<ref name="Shadows" />
